patterns.note: The site uses a dark mode aesthetic with a predominantly black background, providing high contrast for light text and vibrant accent elements.
Key words within large headings are highlighted with a bright accent color, drawing immediate attention to core concepts like 'Superfans' and 'Smarter'.
A striking teal/cyan (#66f2d3) serves as the primary accent color, used for call-to-action buttons, highlighted text, and subtle UI elements, providing a vibrant contrast against the dark background.

The hero section features a background video that remains fixed or subtly parallaxes, creating a dynamic backdrop as the user scrolls, while subsequent content sections animate into view with a subtle fade-up effect.
Feature sections consistently pair descriptive text on one side with detailed product UI mockups on the other, often alternating left and right alignment to maintain visual interest.

technique_notes: The overall design leverages a dark background with high-contrast light text and a single vibrant accent color to create a modern and energetic visual experience.
The hero section integrates a looping background video behind layered product UI mockups, creating a sense of depth and dynamic engagement without distracting from the main message.
Content sections are introduced with a subtle, staggered fade-up animation as they enter the viewport, smoothly revealing information as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with specific words highlighted in an accent color, complemented by legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; buttons and card-like elements feature a slight, consistent rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; the hero section is airy, while content sections maintain clear separation with generous vertical padding.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, dark background paired with a vibrant, almost neon teal accent color creates a high-contrast and energetic aesthetic. The integration of dynamic video backgrounds and detailed product UI mockups within the hero and feature sections effectively showcases the product's capabilities in an engaging and modern way.
